description: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) plugin for OpenCode. It fans out a single prompt to multiple models (subagents) in parallel. The primary agent then evaluates and synthesizes the outputs into a unified, high-quality response. Child worker sessions persist and are navigable via the TUI.
